faqs.question: What is the procedure for booking inquiries through this website?
faqs.answer: Submitting a booking inquiry sends your desired dates and room preferences directly to our private reservations concierge. Our team personally reviews real-time suite inventory and contacts you via phone or email within 2 to 4 hours with guaranteed availability and a customized reservation confirmation.

faqs.question: Are published room rates all-inclusive or subject to confirmation?
faqs.answer: All published prices on this website represent authorized baseline rates in Indian Rupees (₹). Final total pricing, including seasonal adjustments, applicable taxes (GST), and any requested bespoke additions, is formally provided and confirmed by our reservation team before any commitment is finalized.

faqs.question: What are the official check-in and check-out times?
faqs.answer: Check-in commences at 15:00 (3:00 PM), and check-out is at 11:00 AM (12:00 PM for Penthouse & Villa guests). Early check-in or late check-out may be arranged in advance with our concierge team based on availability.

faqs.question: Do you offer private airport transfers and chauffeur services?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our private fleet of luxury house cars provides complimentary transfers within a 5-mile local radius. Private airport transfers from the nearest international airport can be scheduled with our concierge.

faqs.question: What is your cancellation and modification policy?
faqs.answer: Booking inquiries carry zero financial obligation. Once a reservation is confirmed with our front desk, complimentary cancellation is available up to 48 hours prior to arrival date (7 days for Penthouse bookings), after which the first night deposit applies.

faqs.question: Can dietary restrictions and bespoke dining requests be accommodated?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Our culinary teams across The Terrace Restaurant and Saltwater Grill regularly prepare personalized Jain, vegetarian, vegan, and allergen-safe menus. Please note any dietary preferences in your booking inquiry.

testimonials.comment: An extraordinary sanctuary. From our private arrival to the attentive discretion of our butler, every detail at XYZ Hotel whispered understated refinement. The sunset views over the sea from the plunge pool are unforgettable.
The spa and Zen garden villa exceeded every expectation. True peace and privacy, with culinary creations that rival top international establishments. We will certainly return every season.

Booking was remarkably smooth; the concierge phoned us within two hours of our online inquiry and tailored every reservation to our anniversary. The warmth of the hospitality is genuine and world-class.
